data.name: Bhojraj
data.gender_notes: Bhojraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bhojraj is a name derived from Sanskrit words ‘Bhog’ (food) and ‘Raj’ (ruler). This name signifies a ruler or a god who bestows the blessings of food and generosity. The name Bhojraj carries the meaning “God of Food and Generosity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhojraj usually hope their child will grow to embody god of food and generosity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bhojraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Food and Generosity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bhojraj total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: It is customary in Hindu culture to offer food to deities prior to consumption as an act of respect and gratitude. The name “Bhojraj” could be seen as a reverence to the deity responsible for providing the abundant food resources, signifying generosity and hospitality.
data.spiritual_significance: The name “Bhojraj” is also a reminder of the importance of sharing and giving in the spiritual journey. Hindus believe that serving and feeding others is an act of selflessness and devotion towards the divine. This name can serve as a daily inspiration to uphold this virtue and be a blessing to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bhojraj: One who reigns over the nourishing earth (Bhoo) and rules with radiant, regal strength (Raj). Symbolizes the embodiment of prosperity and abundance.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bhojraj Chauhan was a Rajput king who ruled in the 12th century in present-day Rajasthan, India. The name Bhojraj carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: Bhojraj is a popular name among Rajputs in India.
Bhojraj is a name given to boys in the Hindu religion.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bhojraj remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Raj Bhojraj in Hyderabad, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Bhojraj, which means "God of Food and Generosity". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
